options.text: A broad capability for human-like tasks
options.rationale: This describes AI as a broad capability. The application is software that uses that capability.

options.text: A mathematical system trained on data
options.rationale: This describes an ML model. A model can be an engine within an application.
options.better_fit: Use this for a trained ML model.

options.rationale: An AI application is software that uses AI techniques. It performs intelligent tasks for users.

options.text: A service that only stores data
